ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a contiguous block of dark pixels with sparse white mottling near the notch; the right lobe contains a dominant high-intensity white central region bounded by a dark trailing edge margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; visible lobe vectors indicate a converging angle of approximately 50-60 degrees, though the precise apex is occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits fewer, more distinct, sharp-pointed serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a concave curve towards the lateral tip; the left lobe displays a more irregular, broken convexity due to edge degradation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of circular high-contrast white pixel spots visible on the dark lower-quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular serration/tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating historical physical trauma or significant wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly dark left lobe and predominantly light right lobe.
